predictions.claim: Apple announces at least one new hardware product by Oct 31, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if Apple publishes an announcement of a new hardware product (not a color/storage variant of an existing model) between 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-31 inclusive (Pacific time).
predictions.rationale: Apple has shipped October hardware six years running and a smart-home launch is rumored for Oct 13. Shaded below the base rate because the date is unconfirmed and Mac updates already shipped in August.

predictions.claim: Apple holds a livestreamed product event (not press-release-only) between Oct 3 and Nov 30, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if Apple hosts a pre-announced, livestreamed keynote or product video event that premieres on apple.com/apple-events or Apple's YouTube channel between 2026-10-03 and 2026-11-30.
predictions.rationale: A new product category (smart display/HomePad) would normally justify a keynote, but recent fall Mac/iPad launches were press-release or video-only drops without an invite.
predictions.baseline_rule: Status quo: recent October launches were press-release only

predictions.claim: Apple announces a smart display / "HomePad"-type home hub product by Dec 31, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if Apple officially announces a new home device with a built-in display intended as a smart-home hub, by 2026-12-31.
predictions.rationale: The rumor is specific and dated (Oct 13), but Apple's home-hub project has slipped repeatedly in past years. Genuine coin flip.
predictions.baseline_rule: Rumored products with a specific date ship within a quarter

predictions.claim: Gemini 4 Argon becomes available through Google's paid API by Nov 15, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if Google makes Gemini 4 Argon callable by general paid developers (published API pricing, or available in AI Studio / Vertex AI without a special-program application) by 2026-11-15.
predictions.source_of_truth: ai.google.dev pricing/models pages and Google blog
predictions.rationale: Google itself described the staging order (Fairwind first, then paid API and Ultra), which signals a plan. Risk: the government pre-release review process and cyber-capability concerns could delay broad access.
predictions.baseline_rule: Staged releases take longer than implied

predictions.claim: OpenAI publicly releases a model with "Astra" in its name by Dec 31, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if OpenAI makes a model whose official name contains "Astra" available to the public (ChatGPT or API) by 2026-12-31.
predictions.rationale: Reporting on Oct 1 says OpenAI cancelled the Astra release. A cancelled name rarely returns within three months; the 10% covers a rebrand back or a partial release.

predictions.claim: OpenAI lowers GPT-6.1 Sol's standard API price below $2 input / $10 output per million tokens by Dec 31, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if OpenAI's official pricing page lists a standard (non-batch, non-cached) price for GPT-6.1 Sol below $2/M input OR below $10/M output by 2026-12-31.
predictions.rationale: Launch load problems suggest demand is high, which argues against cuts. Labs do cut prices, but usually by shipping a new cheaper model rather than repricing a fresh one. No real edge here.
predictions.baseline_rule: Prices don't move within 3 months of launch

predictions.claim: Tesla officially unveils Optimus Gen 3 by Dec 31, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if Tesla officially presents a robot it calls Optimus Gen 3 / V3 (event, official video, or official post) by 2026-12-31.
predictions.source_of_truth: tesla.com and Tesla/Optimus official X accounts
predictions.rationale: Musk said Gen 3 will be shown closer to production start. The AI5 memory cut suggests the hardware stack is still in flux, and Musk timelines habitually slip.

predictions.claim: Anthropic announces a new Claude model that is not available as of Oct 3, 2026, by Dec 15, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if Anthropic announces and makes available (API or Claude apps) a Claude model with a new name or version number not available on 2026-10-03, by 2026-12-15. Limited previews count only if announced publicly.
predictions.rationale: Anthropic's recent release cadence is roughly every two to three months. I have no inside knowledge of Anthropic's roadmap; this tests whether I'm overconfident about my own maker.

predictions.claim: An open-weights model ranks #1 on LMArena's overall text leaderboard at any point by Dec 31, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if, at any point between 2026-10-03 and 2026-12-31, a model with publicly downloadable weights holds sole or tied #1 rank on LMArena's overall text leaderboard, as shown by LMArena or credible reporting.
predictions.rationale: Chinese open-weights labs are closing the gap fast (GLM-5.3 reportedly matches Claude on exploit tasks), but the overall #1 slot has been held by closed frontier models and new closed releases keep raising the bar.

predictions.claim: Chegg or Penske Media files a notice of appeal of Judge Mehta's dismissal of their AI Overviews antitrust suits by Nov 15, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if either plaintiff files a notice of appeal (or a motion for reconsideration counts as FALSE) by 2026-11-15, as shown in the court docket or credible reporting.
predictions.rationale: The ruling acknowledged publisher harm and the stakes are existential for publishers, which invites appeal. But plaintiffs may first try to amend, or the filing could land after the deadline.

predictions.claim: The Fed holds the federal funds target range at 3.75%-4.00% at its Oct 27-28, 2026 meeting.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if the FOMC statement released at the conclusion of the Oct 27-28, 2026 meeting leaves the target range at 3.75%-4.00%. FALSE for any change.
predictions.rationale: Softer PCE inflation and a weak September jobs report lowered hike odds; UOB and others rule out a back-to-back hike less than a week before the Nov 3 midterms. A cut is near-impossible given the hiking cycle.
predictions.baseline_rule: Prediction-market / CME FedWatch odds of a hold (~80% as of Oct 5)

predictions.claim: The Fed raises the federal funds target range at its December 2026 meeting.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if the FOMC statement at the conclusion of its scheduled December 2026 meeting raises the target range by any amount. FALSE if held or cut, or if the hike comes at an unscheduled meeting instead.
predictions.rationale: September minutes say most participants see another hike by year-end as likely. But inflation and payroll data have softened since; I think the market (~81%) is somewhat overconfident in the hike.
predictions.baseline_rule: Market odds of a December hike (~81% as of Oct 5)

predictions.claim: US CPI for September 2026 (released Oct 14) shows a 12-month all-items increase of 3.5% or higher.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if the BLS CPI-U all-items, not seasonally adjusted, 12-month percent change for September 2026, as first published, is 3.5% or higher. August 2026 was 3.4%.
predictions.rationale: Gas averaged $4.33/gal in September, an energy shock, and the September 2025 monthly headline was +0.3%, so any monthly reading above ~0.3% lifts the annual rate. Uncertain because other components have been soft.

predictions.claim: The US unemployment rate for October 2026 is 4.3% or higher.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate for October 2026 in the BLS Employment Situation report, as first published, is 4.3% or higher. September 2026 was 4.2%.
predictions.rationale: September's payrolls were weak and rates are rising, but the unemployment rate moves slowly month to month and a 0.1-point rise is within noise either way.

predictions.claim: The FDA approves Nuvalent's neladalkib (ALK-positive NSCLC) by Dec 15, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if the FDA approves neladalkib for any indication by 2026-12-15 (PDUFA date Nov 27, 2026), per FDA or Nuvalent announcement.
predictions.rationale: Priority review, strong pivotal data, and a well-understood targeted-therapy class (ALK inhibitors). Main risks are a review extension or manufacturing issues.
predictions.baseline_rule: Priority-review applications are usually approved on first cycle

predictions.claim: The FDA approves Sanofi's venglustat (type 3 Gaucher disease) by Dec 15, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if the FDA approves venglustat for any indication by 2026-12-15 (PDUFA date Nov 25, 2026), per FDA or Sanofi announcement.
predictions.rationale: Venglustat has failed in other indications, and the neurological endpoint in type 3 Gaucher is hard to demonstrate. Priority review helps. This tests whether my skepticism vs. the base rate is warranted.
predictions.baseline_rule: Priority-review applications are usually approved on first cycle

predictions.claim: SpaceX launches a Starship from Florida by Dec 31, 2026.
predictions.resolution_criteria: TRUE if a Starship (ship and/or Super Heavy booster) lifts off from a Florida launch site (e.g., LC-39A or SLC-37) by 2026-12-31. Static fires and tests that don't leave the pad don't count.
predictions.source_of_truth: SpaceX official channels and launch reporting
predictions.rationale: SpaceX is ramping LC-39A work and targeting year-end, but first launches from a new pad historically slip, and Starbase Block 3 work competes for resources.
